name: challenge
description: Challenge a design, plan or proposal with independent agents: critics attack it from named seats, advocates argue rival designs, scenarios are walked through every design, findings are verified and a judge scores. Its one hook, the usage gate, stops any session from launching agents (subagents, workflows, headless claude -p) that the account's usage windows cannot finish. It names nothing of any workspace, so it installs at user scope and works in every project.
